title: Alma Uses PointOne to Automatically Capture Time Across Flat-Fee Immigration Cases
summary: Alma, an AI-native immigration law firm, uses PointOne Time to automatically record legal work, understand the true cost of its flat-fee cases, and guide its internal product roadmap.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 23, 2026** — Today, PointOne announces that Alma, a San Francisco-based AI-native immigration law firm, has rolled out PointOne Time firmwide. Alma delivers legal services under a flat-fee model. Therefore, understanding how much time goes into each application is essential to measuring costs, improving efficiency, and identifying opportunities for automation so its legal team can focus on clients.


With PointOne Time, Alma’s attorneys and paralegals can automatically capture all activity with a digital footprint. PointOne generates complete time entries, giving Alma visibility into how work is distributed across visa types and stages of the immigration process.


"With Harvest, everything was self-reported. Immigration lawyers just aren't used to working with timers. PointOne takes that work off our paralegals' and attorneys' plates by capturing time automatically, so they can stay focused on clients," said Abhinav Kumar, Head of Product at Alma.


Alma also uses the data captured by PointOne to understand which activities consume the most time and guide its internal product roadmap. This helps the firm prioritize automation investments and evaluate how changes affect the cost of delivering legal services. Alma's adoption of PointOne reflects a growing need for reliable time data beyond hourly billing. For firms operating under flat fees, automatic time capture provides visibility into how legal work gets done.


## **About Alma**


Alma is a San Francisco-based, AI-native, full-service immigration law firm covering US and global immigration.


## **About PointOne**


PointOne is the AI timekeeping and work intelligence platform for professional services firms, helping firms understand how work gets done and streamline timekeeping and billing workflows. PointOne Time automatically captures legal work and generates compliant time entries, while PointOne Intelligence gives firms visibility into the economics of their matters. Based in New York City, PointOne is backed by Y Combinator, 8VC, Bessemer Venture Partners, and General Catalyst.
